steps.name: bootstrap-test-environment
steps.run:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends ca-certificates git nodejs python3-pip python3-venv >/tmp/apt-install.log 2>&1
python3 -m venv .venv
. .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --quiet --upgrade pip setuptools wheel
python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --quiet -r requirements-dev.txt playwright==1.55.0
if ! python -m playwright install --with-deps chromium >/tmp/playwright-install.log 2>&1; then
  tail -n 200 /tmp/playwright-install.log
  exit 1
fi
tail -n 40 /tmp/playwright-install.log
python --version
python -c "import PIL; print('Pillow', PIL.__version__)"
node --version
ruff --version
pytest --version

steps.name: full-readable-diagram-real-vi-regression
steps.run:
set -Eeuo pipefail
. .venv/bin/activate
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
export BUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR="$PWD/artifacts/readable-diagram-density"
export WORK_ROOT="$PWD/.sandbox-pytest-jobs"
rm -rf "$BUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR" "$WORK_ROOT"
mkdir -p "$BUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR" "$WORK_ROOT"
LOG="$BUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR/full-validation.log"
set +e
bash scripts/sandbox_readable_diagram_test.sh >"$LOG" 2>&1
status=$?
set -e
grep -v '^READABLE_CONTACT_SHEET_B64_' "$LOG" | tail -n 320 || true
exit "$status"

steps.name: publish-validation-evidence
steps.run:
set -Eeuo pipefail
SRC="$PWD/artifacts/readable-diagram-density"
OUT="$PWD/.local_relay/output"
rm -rf "$OUT"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
find "$SRC" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.json' -exec cp {} "$OUT/" \;
grep -v '^READABLE_CONTACT_SHEET_B64_' "$SRC/full-validation.log" >"$OUT/full-validation.log" || true
cp "$SRC/readable-diagram-contact-sheet.jpg" "$OUT/"
for name in readable-basic-1440x900.png readable-flow-1440x900.png readable-huge-overview-1440x900.png real-readability-1440x900.png; do
  test -s "$SRC/$name"
  cp "$SRC/$name" "$OUT/"
done
python3 - <<'PY'
from __future__ import annotations
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
out = Path('.local_relay/output')
entries = []
for path in sorted(p for p in out.iterdir() if p.is_file() and p.name != 'manifest.json'):
    data = path.read_bytes()
    entries.append({'path': path.name, 'bytes': len(data), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()})
(out / 'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps({'files': entries}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'evidence_files': len(entries), 'evidence_bytes': sum(item['bytes'] for item in entries)}, separators=(',', ':')))
PY
find "$OUT" -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f %s bytes\n' | sort
